description: Flex row that switches to a column once the container is narrower than the threshold. Attribute form: data-layout="switcher".

attributes.name: data-layout-gap
attributes.description: Gap between items, on the shared size scale.

attributes.name: data-layout-threshold
attributes.description: Container width at which the row becomes a column: 25 / 30 / 40rem. One-off: style="--layout-threshold: 35rem".

attributes.name: data-layout-limit
attributes.description: Force the column layout once there are more than this many items.

attributes.name: data-layout-reverse
attributes.description: Reverse the visual order when stacked.
